subject.title: Cron sessions deliver hallucinated output instead of failing cleanly when tool calls fail

question: What should OpenClaw do by default when an unattended cron run has failed or missing required tool work but the model still emits deliverable final text?
rationale: The remaining fix changes a security-sensitive delivery boundary and may alter existing cron behavior, so automation should not choose the default fail-open, warn-and-deliver, or fail-closed policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Fail closed for unattended runs
options.body: Treat unresolved failed required or mutating tool work as run failure or no normal delivery, with structured failure alerting and focused cron/agent tests.

options.title: Warn and deliver
options.body: Preserve current delivery behavior but attach visible failure warnings when the tool ledger contradicts or fails to support the final text.

options.title: Keep broad claim checks plugin-first
options.body: Limit core to structured fatal tool/error states and leave natural-language success-claim verification to ClawHub plugins.

recommendation.title: Fail closed for unattended runs
recommendation.body: Treat unresolved failed required or mutating tool work as run failure or no normal delivery, with structured failure alerting and focused cron/agent tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on cron delivery/default policy and this is a core runtime security-boundary choice.
